title: 간접의문문 (Do you know where it is?)
goal: Do you know ~? / Can you tell me ~? 뒤에 질문을 넣어 공손하게 묻고, I don't know ~로 모른다고 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: 질문을 문장 속에 넣기
points.body: Where is the station?(역이 어디예요?)을 Do you know ~? 뒤에 넣으면 Do you know where the station is?(역이 어디 있는지 아세요?)가 돼요. 이렇게 문장 속에 들어간 질문을 간접의문문이라고 해요. 훨씬 부드럽고 공손하게 들려요.

points.title: 순서는 '의문사 + 주어 + 동사'
points.body: 질문 속으로 들어가면 순서가 평소 문장처럼 바뀌어요. where is the station (X) → where the station is (O). 의문사 바로 뒤에 주어, 그다음 동사예요.

points.title: do / does / did는 빠져요
points.body: What time does the shop open? → Do you know what time the shop opens? does가 사라지는 대신 동사에 -s가 붙어요. 과거 did도 빠지고 동사가 과거형이 돼요. Where did she go? → I don't know where she went.

points.title: 의문사가 없으면 if
points.body: Is he at home?처럼 의문사가 없는 질문은 if(~인지)를 넣어요. I don't know if he is at home.(그가 집에 있는지 모르겠어요.)

points.title: 자주 쓰는 앞부분
points.body: Do you know ~?(~ 아세요?), Can you tell me ~? / Could you tell me ~?(~ 알려 주실래요?), I don't know ~(~ 모르겠어요), I'm not sure ~(~ 잘 모르겠어요). 처음 보는 사람에게 길을 물을 때 특히 좋아요.

formula: Do you know + 의문사 + 주어 + 동사 ~?
Can you tell me + 의문사 + 주어 + 동사 ~?
I don't know + 의문사 + 주어 + 동사.
Do you know + if + 주어 + 동사 ~? (의문사 없을 때)

mistakes.wrong: Do you know where is the bus stop?
mistakes.right: Do you know where the bus stop is?
mistakes.why: 원래 질문(Where is ~?) 순서를 그대로 쓰는 실수예요. 질문 속에서는 주어(the bus stop) 다음에 동사(is)를 써요.

mistakes.wrong: Can you tell me what time does the shop close?
mistakes.right: Can you tell me what time the shop closes?
mistakes.why: 질문 속에서는 does를 빼고, 주어가 하나(the shop)니까 동사에 -s를 붙여요.

mistakes.wrong: I don't know is he at home.
mistakes.right: I don't know if he is at home.
mistakes.why: 의문사가 없는 질문은 앞에 if를 넣고, 순서를 he is로 바꿔요.

examples.en: Do you know where the nearest ATM is?
examples.ko: 가장 가까운 ATM이 어디 있는지 아세요?

examples.en: Can you tell me what time the tram leaves?
examples.ko: 트램이 몇 시에 출발하는지 알려 주실래요?

examples.en: I don't know how much the rent is.
Do you know if the café is hiring?
examples.ko: 그 카페가 사람을 뽑고 있는지 아세요?

examples.en: I don't know where my housemate went.
Could you tell me when the interview starts?
Do you know why the beach is closed today?
I'm not sure if this bus goes to the city.
examples.ko: 이 버스가 시내로 가는지 잘 모르겠어요.

quiz.sentence: Do you know where the post office ___?
choices: is
are
does
do
quiz.why: 질문 속에서는 주어(the post office) 뒤에 동사가 와요. 주어가 하나라서 is예요.

quiz.sentence: Can you tell me what time the shop ___?
choices: closes
close
closing
to close
quiz.ko: 가게가 몇 시에 닫는지 알려 주실래요?
quiz.why: does가 빠지는 대신 동사에 -s가 붙어서 closes예요.

quiz.sentence: I don't know ___ he is at home.
choices: if
does
is
do
quiz.why: 의문사가 없는 질문(Is he at home?)은 if를 넣어요.

quiz.sentence: Do you know where she ___ last night?
choices: went
go
goes
going
quiz.why: did가 빠지면 동사를 과거형으로 써요. go → went.

quiz.sentence: Can you tell me ___ much this shirt is?
choices: how
what
where
who

quiz.answer: Do you know where the train station is?
choices: Do you know where the train station is?
Do you know where is the train station?
Do you know where does the train station is?
Do you know the train station where is?
quiz.why: 의문사(where) + 주어(the train station) + 동사(is) 순서예요.

quiz.answer: I don't know what time the interview starts.
choices: I don't know what time the interview starts.
I don't know what time does the interview start.
I don't know what time the interview start.
I don't know what time starts the interview.
quiz.why: does는 빼고 주어 + 동사-s(starts) 순서로 써요.

quiz.answer: Do you know if he is Australian?
choices: Do you know if he is Australian?
Do you know is he Australian?
Do you know if is he Australian?
Do you know what he is Australian?

quiz.ko: 그녀가 왜 일을 그만뒀는지 알려 줄 수 있어요?
quiz.answer: Can you tell me why she quit her job?
choices: Can you tell me why she quit her job?
Can you tell me why did she quit her job?
Can you tell me why does she quit her job?
Can you tell me why quit she her job?
quiz.why: did를 빼고 why + she + quit(과거형) 순서예요. quit은 과거형도 quit이에요.

quiz.answer: Do you know how much the ticket is?
choices: Do you know how much the ticket is?
Do you know how much is the ticket?
Do you know how much does the ticket is?
Do you know how much the ticket are?
quiz.why: how much + 주어(the ticket) + is 순서가 맞아요.

quiz.answer: I don't know where he lives.
choices: I don't know where he lives.
I don't know where does he live.
I don't know where he live.
I don't know where lives he.
quiz.why: does를 빼고 he + lives(-s) 순서로 써요.

quiz.answer: Can you tell me if the bus stops here?
choices: Can you tell me if the bus stops here?
Can you tell me does the bus stop here?
Can you tell me if does the bus stop here?
Can you tell me if the bus stop here?
